title: The Payment App Built for Digital Nomads and Expats
summary: Money without borders. Send, spend, and save across borders with Blaze, built for nomads, expats, and global businesses.
body_markdown:
Imagine this: You've just landed in Mexico City, a bustling metropolis full of vibrant culture, delicious food, and exciting opportunities. After a long day of exploring the historic sites, you meet up at a rooftop bar in Roma Norte with four of your new friends. Everyone is from a different country, bringing their quirky experiences and stories to the table.


**Vibes are high. Life is good.**


But then comes the tricky part: splitting the bill.


> Everyone uses a different currency and payment method. The waiter stands patiently as you all fumble through wallets, trying to figure out the best way to pay each other back. Some suggest using cash, while others prefer bank transfers or various payment apps.


The evening ends on a slightly sour note as everyone struggles to settle the payments.


**Sound familiar?**


This scenario is all too common for digital nomads. Managing finances while constantly on the move shouldn't be this hard.


---


## Enter Blaze


Blaze is designed to make sending money while exploring easier and more efficient. As the payment app built specifically for digital nomads, our mission is simple:


> **Enable you to pay anyone, no matter where you are in the world.**


---


## Why Digital Nomads Choose Blaze


### 🌍 Global


With Blaze, you can pay in any currency, anywhere in the world. No matter where your adventures take you, Blaze ensures that managing your finances is never a hassle.


**Currently live in:**


- 🇲🇽 Mexico
- 🇺🇸 United States
- 🇪🇺 Europe (coming soon)
- 🇧🇷 Brazil (coming soon)


### ⚡ Instant


Time is of the essence, especially when you're on the move. Blaze allows you to send and receive funds in seconds.


> **Say goodbye to the days of waiting 3-5 business days for international transfers.** With Blaze, your transactions complete instantly, giving you more time to enjoy your journey.


### 🎯 Easy


Whether you're sending money to a friend or paying a bill, Blaze makes the process quick and straightforward:


- Find friends by **phone number**
- Connect via **email** or **Instagram**
- Scan a **QR code** at checkout
- No account numbers needed—ever
